newsitem.title: INDIA: India Ashok to raise 2.0 bln rupee debt.
newsitem.headline: India Ashok to raise 2.0 bln rupee debt.

text.p: Indian truckmaker Ashok Leyland Ltd is raising 2.0 billion rupees through a private placement of debt at a coupon rate of 14.0 percent per annum, a company official said on Wednesday.
"The response has been overwhelming," K.Sridharan, deputy general manager (corporate finance) told Reuters. "We expect close to 1.0 billion rupees to flow in by tomorrow."

The five-year paper is fully secured by assets of the company, he said. ANZ Investment Bank, Ashok Leyland Investment Services, Peregrine Capital and SBI Capital Markets are the arrangers to the issue.
"We believe 14.0 percent coupon is a new benchmark for five-year paper," Sridharan said.
Ashok Leyland is India's second largest truck maker.
